Beth was asking about some ingests which I found with this same error. Paths:

- /mnt/hydra_sources/studio_new/DPUL/beth/SovietEphemera/MVWs/32101115043257
- /mnt/hydra_sources/studio_new/DPUL/beth/SovietEphemera/MVWs/32101115043224

She mentioned that they are MVWs:

"I have a question about using Ephemera Bulk Ingest - Can you ingest MVW through it? Anna Meerson has a collection of original art used for political cartoons and for two of the items there are 2 iterations of the final art. So they share the same barcode number, but are two separate items. I was hoping to have the barcode and then poster_1 and poster_2 within that barcode with recto/verso.  This is one of the barcodes that I attempted to upload that way - 32101115043257 - it doesn't appear to have worked. Is it still spinning? Does it just take a lot longer? It's been a few hours since I ingested it."

Okay, this was probably 2 separate issues:

The first one, a regular bulk ingest but the wrong directory was selected. These should go in find if re-run selecting `/mnt/hydra_sources/studio_new/DPUL/roel/ingest/lae/32101117769370` as the base ingest directory.

The second, an intentional MVW folder ingest, but that's not supported. Recommended strategy is to ingest the images onto one item and use the structure manager to add that context.
